[P2] Release the lease after confirmed executor termination

If `awaitTermination()` succeeds but this subsequent `isShutdown()` call throws, the terminated executor remains permanently in the static `ACTIVE_INVOCATION_EXECUTORS` set. Finalization then sets `cleanupFinished`, so automatic close cannot release it. Repeated invocations using such an executor accumulate retained pools and their captured state in a warm JVM. Release the lease when termination is confirmed, independently of this later state query, while retaining the query failure. Add a regression test that verifies lease release after successful termination followed by a throwing state query.
